agents.name: Cover Letter Research and Relevance Agent

issues: Sentences reference evidence IDs (e.g., job.title, job.company, job.required_skills) that are not present in the supplied evidence list.

provider.export_scope: Selected evidence, grounded sentences and job requirements; no signature or contact details.
provider.correction: The agent reviewer raised a reference concern. One independent host check verified every selected sentence and evidence ID against the immutable source catalogue; no unknown claims, duplicates or missing required sections remained.

agent_issues: Sentences reference evidence IDs (e.g., job.title, job.company, job.required_skills) that are not present in the supplied evidence list.

validation.grounding: catalogue-checked agent claims; separately attributed user text
